defs.def: happening, done or produced every day 每日的；日常的

ex.s: Reducing car use in daily life.
ex.t: 在日常生活中减少汽车使用。

ex.s: While eating and enjoying street performances, they chat with each other and share stories of their daily lives.
ex.t: 人们一边吃吃喝喝、欣赏街头表演，一边相互聊天，分享日常生活的故事。

ex.s: The Barcelona subway pulls into the station, the doors slide open and passengers pour out to go about their daily business.
ex.t: 巴塞罗那地铁驶入车站，门滑开，乘客涌出，去忙各自日常的事。

ex.s: Fishermen go out to sea daily and sell their fish in harbor-side markets.
ex.t: 渔民每天出海，在港区市场售卖他们的鱼。

ex.s: They are fond of sharing daily experiences.
ex.t: 他们喜欢分享日常经历。

ex.s: chair daily meetingsB. evaluate the exchange
ex.t: 主持每日会议B. 评估交换效果

ex.s: “We’re trying to generate a language that helps bring the human-nature interactions back into our daily lives.
ex.t: 我们正试图创造一种语言，帮助把人与自然的互动带回到我们的日常生活中。

ex.s: Its ideas can be applied to daily life.
ex.t: 它的思想可以应用到日常生活中。

ex.s: Growing up in San Francisco, Grace Young used to watch her father shop daily in Chinatown for whatever he needed to make traditional Chinese meals at home.
ex.t: 在旧金山长大的格雷丝·杨，常常看着父亲每天在唐人街采购，为他要在家做的传统中餐准备所需的一切。

ex.s: Daily assignments not completed during class will get a zero.
ex.t: 课堂上未完成的日常作业将得零分。

ex.s: The Museum is open daily from 9：30 am to 4：30 pm.
ex.t: 博物馆每天上午9:30至下午4:30开放。

ex.s: It may increase daily expenses.
ex.t: 它可能会增加日常开支。

ex.s: Open: Daily, 09.30 – 17.30 (last admission 17.00).
Humor also transports your mind away from your daily troubles.
ex.t: 幽默还能让你的思绪从日常烦恼中转移开来。

ex.s: All that week, Poppy didn’t seem interested in her dinner, her favorite toy, or even in her daily walk.
ex.t: 那一整周，波比似乎对她的晚餐、最爱的玩具，甚至每日的散步都不感兴趣。

ex.s: Gordon says his students are emailing daily with NASA engineers about the problem, readying a workable solution to test in space.
ex.t: 戈登说，他的学生每天就这个问题与NASA工程师邮件往来，准备一个可在太空测试的可行方案。

ex.s: If they run out of certain daily necessities.
ex.t: 如果他们用完了某些日常必需品。

ex.s: Balancing Our Daily Diet
ex.t: 平衡我们的日常饮食

ex.s: get rid of some bad habits in our daily life
ex.t: B． 改掉日常生活中一些坏习惯

ex.s: You wouldn’t think that a few    58   (month) of exercise in your teens would be enough    59    the rest of your life, and that’s also true for building your vocabulary—you have to keep at it daily, and pretty soon you will find that you have an excellent vocabulary.
ex.t: 你不会认为十几岁时几____58____（month 个月）的锻炼就足以____59____（受益）余生，建立词汇量也是如此——你必须每天坚持，很快你就会发现自己拥有出色的词汇量。

ex.s: You would think learning takes more time from you, but actually there are always new ways of doing things that can save you time on daily tasks, freeing you up for the most important.
ex.t: 你或许以为学习占用了你更多时间，但其实总有新的做事方式能让你在日常任务上节省时间，从而腾出精力处理最重要的事。

ex.s: Daily practice after class at the school.
ex.t: 课后在学校进行日常练习。

ex.s: Environment awareness is now part of daily life.
ex.t: 环保意识如今已成为日常生活的一部分。

ex.s: Reducing daily food waste by just 5% could save millions of people from starvation.
ex.t: 仅将每日食物浪费减少5%，就能让数百万人免于饥饿。

ex.s: Emma spent an hour with me in the staff room talking me through the daily routine.
ex.t: 埃玛在教员休息室花了一个小时陪我梳理了日常的例行安排。

ex.s: Staying alive will be a daily challenge, but as proved by the Biosphere 2 experiment, not impossible.
ex.t: 活着将是一项日常挑战，但正如生物圈2实验所证明的那样，并非不可能。

ex.s: Daily Work/In-Class Writings and Tests/Group Work/Homework (10%)
ex.t: 日常作业/课堂写作和测试/小组作业/家庭作业（10%）

ex.s: Many people think that positive thinking is mostly about keeping one's head in the sand and ignoring daily problems, trying to look optimistic.
ex.t: 许多人认为积极思维主要是把头埋进沙里、忽视日常问题、试图显得乐观。

defs.def: connected with one day's work 每个工作日的；按日的

ex.s: Bonds, who bought his first cattle almost 50 years ago, still has each of his cowboys inspect 300 or 400 cattle daily and look for signs that an animal is getting sick.
ex.t: 邦德在近50年前购买了他的第一头牛，他仍然让每个牛仔每天检查300或400头牛，并寻找动物生病的迹象。

ex.s: Now Irene Astbury works from 9am to 5pm daily at the pet shop in Macclesfield，   62   she opened with her late husband Les.
ex.t: 现在艾琳·阿茨伯里每天上午9点到下午5点在马克尔斯菲尔德的宠物店工作，这家店是她和她已故的丈夫莱斯一起开的。

ex.s: The café is located upstairs in Building 1 and is open daily until one hour before Pacific Science Center closes.
ex.t: 咖啡厅位于1号楼楼上，每天开放至太平洋科学中心闭馆前一小时。

ex.s: （1）What is Mabry's daily work as a school keeper？ （no more than 5 words）
ex.t: （1）作为校工，梅布里的日常工作是什么？（不超过5个词）

defs.def: a newspaper published every day except Sunday （除星期日外每日发行的）日报

ex.s: But that didn't stop China Daily from asking me last week to share a personal story for a video project about the integration of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei province.
ex.t: 但这并没有阻止《中国日报》上周邀请我为一个关于京津冀一体化的视频项目分享个人故事。

ex.s: "I often send postcards to family and friends." he says to China Daily, "but you can imagine that after a while, you never receive as many as you send, and you realize that not everyone is into it   32   ” Seeking other like-minded souls, however, Paulo started looking in a somewhat unlikely place: online.
ex.t: “我经常给家人和朋友寄明信片，”他对《中国日报》说，“但你可以想象，过一阵子后，你收到的永远不会和你寄出的一样多，你会意识到不是每个人都像你一样热衷于它____32____”不过，为了寻找其他志同道合的人，保罗开始在一个不太可能的地方寻找：网上。

defs.def: a person employed to come to sb's house each day to clean it and do other jobs （不寄宿的）仆人

chunks.en: daily life / diet / tasks / routine / troubles / business / challenge
chunks.cn: 日常生活 / 日常饮食 / 日常任务 / 日常作息 / 日常烦恼 / 日常事务 / 日常挑战
